info.title: Rent Manager Backend API
info.description: Comprehensive interactive REST API documentation with full Request & Response DTO schemas, Zod validation models, module clustering, and JWT Bearer authentication.

tags.name: Authentication
tags.description: User authentication, identity sessions, and initial admin bootstrap

tags.name: User Management
tags.description: Admin user account querying, role updates, and unit associations

tags.name: Tenant Operations
tags.description: Tenant onboarding lifecycle, KYC document submissions, agreement verification, and S3 pre-signed downloads

tags.name: Rentable Units
tags.description: Room/flat catalog, unit specifications, tenant assignment, and vacating workflows

tags.name: Property Dashboard
tags.description: Interactive property layout tree, floor/unit hierarchies, and aggregated occupancy summaries

tags.name: Payment Management
tags.description: Offline payment recording, FIFO arrears allocation, tenant rent ledger, and receipt voiding

tags.name: Payment Destinations
tags.description: UPI IDs, bank transfer destinations, and cash collection management

post.description: Validates user credentials and returns a signed JWT Bearer token.
post.summary: Authenticate user with email and password

post.description: Creates the primary ADMIN user account if no admin currently exists.

get.description: Fetches the authenticated user's account details and assigned unit.

post.description: Admin pre-registers a tenant account and links their assigned unit code.

get.description: Searches users by email or phone query parameters.
get.summary: Search user accounts by query parameters (Admin only)

patch.description: Admin update of user account fields (name, phone, role).
patch.summary: Update user account profile details (Admin only)

delete.description: Permanently removes a user account from the system.

post.description: Tenant completes their personal onboarding form (Aadhaar, address, occupation, emergency contact).

get.description: Returns the caller's complete tenant profile with pre-signed document URLs.
get.summary: Get logged-in tenant's own profile and documents

patch.description: Allows tenant to update permanent address, emergency contact, or occupation.

post.description: Tenant submits intent to move out. Calculates default notice period deadline from room specs.

get.description: Returns any active pending or served move-out notice for the caller's tenancy.
get.summary: Get current active move-out notice for logged-in tenant

post.description: Uploads Aadhaar card & passport photo to private AWS S3 and marks agreementStatus as SUBMITTED.
post.summary: Phase 2: Submit Aadhar & Photo (Multipart file upload)

get.description: Retrieves all tenant records with populated user info and pre-signed document URLs.
get.summary: Get all tenant profiles with unit associations (Admin only)

delete.description: Deletes tenant profile, frees assigned unit to vacant, and purges S3 documents.
delete.summary: Delete tenant record and dissociate unit (Admin only)

get.description: Fetches a single tenant document by ObjectId with pre-signed document URLs.
get.summary: Get specific tenant profile by ID (Admin or owner)

patch.description: Admin updates tenant address, contact details, or occupancy.

get.description: Admin inbox filterable by status (PENDING, NOTICE_SERVED, COMPLETED, REJECTED) and initiatedBy (TENANT, ADMIN).
get.summary: List all move-out notices across properties (Admin only)

patch.description: Admin approves (executes atomic room vacate) or rejects a tenant-submitted move-out notice.

post.description: Admin serves formal move-out notice with target deadline and optional reason.
post.summary: Serve move-out / eviction notice to tenant (Admin only)

patch.description: Admin verifies (VERIFIED), rejects (REJECTED), or uploads signed agreement PDF.
patch.summary: Update agreement status, upload signed PDF, or delete agreement (Admin only)

patch.description: Quick override: 'Paid' records a real PaymentRecord; 'Pending' voids the latest paid month. 'Overdue' is derived.
patch.summary: Quick override tenant rent status (Paid / Pending) backed by ledger (Admin only)

get.description: Generates a time-limited (1-hour) pre-signed download URL for a specific document (aadharCard, passportPhoto, agreementPdf).
get.summary: Generate fresh on-demand Pre-Signed GET URL for a private S3 document

get.description: Returns the full details and specifications of the caller's assigned unit.
get.summary: Get rentable unit assigned to logged-in tenant

get.description: Retrieves units filterable by status (occupied/vacant/pending), type, or property.
get.summary: List all rentable units with optional filters (Public / Filterable)

get.description: Fetches a unit by its 24-character ObjectId or human-readable unitCode.
get.summary: Get unit details by ObjectId or unitCode (e.g. B-101)

patch.description: Admin updates unit rent amount, name, specifications, or snapshots.
patch.summary: Update rentable unit specifications, rent, and details (Admin only)

post.description: Sets unit status to occupied and establishes bidirectional tenant link.
post.summary: Assign rentable unit to a tenant (Admin only)

post.description: Atomically snapshots unit onto tenant, marks tenancyStatus as VACATED, resets unit to vacant, and completes open notices.
post.summary: Vacate rentable unit atomically and preserve tenant history (Admin only)

get.description: Returns the primary hierarchical building layout tree used by the frontend interactive dashboard.
get.summary: Get aggregated property tree with floors, units, tenant IDs, and pre-signed document URLs

get.description: Fetches a quick list of top-level building property identifiers and display labels.
get.summary: List unique building/property names and IDs

get.description: Returns primary UPI ID or bank account details displayed to tenants for offline rent transfer.
get.summary: Get active default payment destination for tenant rent payments

post.description: Creates a new payment destination record with IFSC / UPI VPA format validation.
post.summary: Create UPI / Bank Transfer / Cash payment destination (Admin only)

get.description: Fetches a specific payment method configuration by ObjectId.
get.summary: Get payment destination details by ID (Admin only)

patch.description: Updates UPI ID, bank account details, or cash collection contact person.

delete.description: Permanently removes a payment destination option.

get.description: Lists all configured payment methods across active and disabled states.
get.summary: Get all payment destinations including inactive (Admin only)

patch.description: Enables or disables a payment destination from being visible to tenants.
patch.summary: Toggle payment destination active/inactive state (Admin only)

patch.description: Marks this payment method as the default destination and demotes others.
patch.summary: Set payment destination as primary default for rent collection (Admin only)

post.description: Records payment, settles oldest unpaid months in FIFO order, enforces debt ceiling, and syncs tenant rentStatus.
post.summary: Record offline payment for single or multi-month lump sum with FIFO settlement (Admin only)

get.description: Admin payment receipts log filterable by date range, payment method, unit, or tenant.
get.summary: Filterable payment ledger across properties (by tenant, unit, month, method) (Admin only)

get.description: Returns personal rent ledger, current month status, maxAcceptableAmount, and historical payment receipts.
get.summary: Get logged-in tenant's rent breakdown, paid months, overdue arrears, and receipts

get.description: Calculates total unpaid months, totalDueAmount, maxAcceptableAmount, and full receipt history.
get.summary: Get detailed rent ledger and arrears breakdown for a tenant (Admin or owner)

delete.description: Voids a mistaken payment record, re-opens the settled months as unpaid/overdue, and recalculates ledger.
delete.summary: Void/delete a payment record and re-evaluate tenant rent status (Admin only)

bearerAuth.description: Enter your JWT token (without Bearer prefix in Swagger UI)

temporaryPassword.description: Initial temporary password (defaults to Tenant@12345 if omitted)

aadharNumber.description: 12-digit Indian Aadhar number (formatted or raw digits)

permanentAddress.example: Flat 4B, Salt Lake Sector V, Kolkata, WB - 700091

rejectionReason.example: Aadhar photo is blurry. Please upload clear scan.

deleteAgreementPdf.description: Set to true to permanently purge all versions of the signed agreement PDF from S3

rentStatus.description: Status override. 'Overdue' is a derived ledger calculation and cannot be manually set.

intendedVacateDate.description: Target move-out date (defaults to today + notice period months if omitted)

reason.example: Relocating to another city for employment

intendedVacateDate.description: Formal move-out deadline date served by admin

adminNotes.example: Security deposit reconciliation will be processed upon inspection

action.description: APPROVE_AND_VACATE executes atomic room vacating; REJECT cancels notice

amount.description: Total payment amount in INR (e.g. ₹9,000 for 2 months)

monthsCovered.description: List of YYYY-MM months settled (Leave empty for automatic FIFO allocation)

transactionReference.description: Bank UTR, transaction ID, or cash receipt number

notes.example: Paid 2 months rent via Google Pay

permanentAddress.example: Flat 4B, Salt Lake Sector V, Kolkata

url.description: Authenticated pre-signed GET URL valid for 1 hour

bio.example: Corner 1 BHK flat with open balcony

maxAcceptableAmount.description: Maximum allowable payment amount equal to cumulative outstanding dues

message.example: Payment recorded successfully and rent status synchronized
